title: Base coefficients in a relative Proj chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, A a graded algebra datum [def-nagata-relative-proj], U an affine base open, r a section of O_S on U, and x a point of the U Proj chart above U. Pull r back along the relative Proj structural map and then its chart inclusion. Evaluation at x, as an element of the ordinary localization at the homogeneous prime x, is algebraMap(r)/1. This asserts only a structure-sheaf section identity.

source.place: Tags 01ME and 01NQ, structural morphism on affine Proj charts

proof.text: The relative Proj chart followed by its structural map is the affine Proj structural map followed by the inclusion of U.

Expand toSpecOfAlgebra and toSpecZero. The latter uses fromZeroRingHom and awayToSection on D_+(1), which is the whole Proj. Cancel the section isomorphisms for open subschemes. The pointwise awayToSection formula is further localization, and IsLocalization.map_eq shows that a/1 maps to a/1. This gives the asserted coefficient identity.
